name: context-bar
description: A full-width, color-segmented context window bar above the prompt, with handoff and compact buttons; ships /handoff and /handoff-resume

handoffCommand.title: Handoff command
handoffCommand.description: The slash command the handoff button runs, without the slash. The mod ships /handoff; name your own command here to use it instead. Leave it empty to hide the button. The button also hides when the command isn't installed.

resumeCommand.title: Resume command
resumeCommand.description: The slash command the handoff button runs right after a handoff, without the slash. The mod ships /handoff-resume. Leave it empty, or name a command that isn't installed, and the button always runs the handoff command.
